DataProtection.//: Key ring backing Blazor Server's interactive-component markers and antiforgery tokens. Explicit + deploy-safe: it lives under the persistent data root (Deploy-ToLinux.ps1's rsync --delete only wipes api/ and web/) and is derived without reference to HOME, so radio-web.service's ProtectHome=true cannot strand it in a read-only /home. Resolves relative to the process working directory -> /opt/radio-console/data/keys-web on the box, which is inside the unit's ReadWritePaths. Deliberately separate from the API's ./data/keys so the secrets ring holds only API-created keys. See design/plans/SECRET-KEYRING-INVESTIGATION.md.
